description: Named code created with `def`; its body runs each time the function is called.
A parameter is a name in the `def` line; an argument is the value the caller passes for it.
Ends the function and hands a value to the caller. Without it, the call gives back `None`.
`percent=10` in the `def` line is used when the caller leaves it out; `percent=25` in a call names the parameter it sets.
`low, high = pair` gives each value of a returned tuple its own name; `_` marks a value you ignore.
A name created inside a function. It exists only while the function runs.
